content:
Key
Value
access_code
A numeric string that the user must provide to enable redirection
to Persona.
expires_at
The expiration timestamp of the access code.
inquiry_id
The inquiry ID created by Persona.
status
The current identify verification status. One of:
Status
Description
created
The identity verification process has been
initiated.
started
The user has begun the identity verification
process.
expired
The access code or identity verification
process has expired.
verified
The user identity has been confirmed.
failed
The user identity has not been confirmed.
unknown
An unexpected error occurred during the
process.
canceled
The identity verification process was canceled.
updated_at
The timestamp indicating when the record was last updated.
